profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: With a background in creative and professional arts, I bring a unique and objective eye to my work. I seek opportunities in which I can use my leadership skills and drive for learning towards engineering roles that create a brighter future through technology.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built new features and maintained legacy code using Ruby on Rails, MongoDB, Typescript, Node.js, React, React Query, Chakra UI, Material UI, Apollo and GraphQL

Developed and launched multiple high profile greenfield projects to a customer base of over 500,000 users

Implemented integrations with Auth0, Microsoft Teams, Slack, Avalara, Stripe, Chargebee, ChiliPiper and Hubspot

Hackathon guild member, accessibility and DEI advocate

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: PostgreSQL · React.js · Ruby on Rails · TypeScript · Node.js

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Lead and major contributor to E-Commerce and ERP system Features
• Overhauled promotional code system to incorporate product associations, shopping cart and customer qualifications, blacklisting and requiring of products and product categories, mass customer based promotional code generator, and a csv uploader
• Built a developer dashboard to visualize current and historic sprint data as well as to show aggregate and individual team member overviews through Bugzilla, GitHub, and Jira integrations
• Used D3.js to create data visualizations of company demographics
• Continuous work on integration of drop-ship operations into the current workflow including new commerce features, ERP modifications, upgrades, updates, and restructuring of the shopping cart and checkout features to accept the new flow
Responsible for maintenance, upgrades, and updates including resolving bugs, modifications, spam control, cron jobs, services, graphics, mailers, ACLs, RSS enhancements, and documentation

positions.title: Learn Expert
positions.description:
• Assist students with technological and conceptual education in a real-time chat environment 
• Provide resources, resolve and escalate issues as needed

positions.title: Activities Administrator
positions.description:
• Coordinated and implemented activities for 7 assisted living facilities, accommodating for an average of 80 residents. 
• Program organizer of "Memories in the Making" which included attending Alzheimer's Association workshops and initiating the art therapy program within the many residences. 
• Maintained inventory of activity related materials, including research and ordering of materials.

positions.title: Health Services Specialist
positions.description:
• Oversaw health and safety for 3 childcare facilities and approximately 100 individual children in the Early Head Start program. 
• Created data systems to track and coordinate health and safety metrics for all children within the program. 
• Attended a national Early Head Start conference and implemented learned knowledge within the program.
• Developed community relationships to provide families with resources for health and safety needs. 
• Consistently met all guidelines, deadlines and time frames established by the programs federal grant mandated regulations. 
• Served on the Health Services Advisory Committee.

positions.title: Personal Chef
positions.description:
• Performed all marketing and administrative functions to find, build, and retain clients for own entrepreneurial business “For the Health of It,” including conducting client outreach, developing marketing materials, and keeping the business materials organized.
• Developed and prepared meals, meal plans, and event menus for various clients that were specially tailored to each client’s individual needs.
• Catered events and culinary functions, prepared, planned, and executed all courses. 2-3 major events per year including hiring and management of additional staff and services as needed.
• Created and maintened personal website and blog as an informative data base for clientele.

positions.title: Chef instructor
positions.description:
• Designed, planned, and lead a wide variety of specialized cooking classes at an upscale culinary boutique.
• Taught hands-on and demonstration-format cooking classes for up to 20 people at a time incorporating easy to follow take home instruction booklets and humor to ensure participants learn new skills and have a good time.

positions.title: Sous Chef
positions.description:
• Ran all stations on the line in a high pressure environment, including managing 6 people and having final decision making power on the kitchen staff.
• Managed and trained staff, including training staff on various techniques, recipes, and station requirements, scheduling shifts, and overseeing staff productivity, which resulted in a more efficient, cleaner, well educated, and productive kitchen and staff.
• Oversaw order placement, including managing food costs, building relationships with various vendors, and acting as liaison between kitchen staff and management.

honors.title: Magna Cum Laude
honors.issuer: Issued by The University of Colorado Denver · Dec 2014

projects.title: Colorado Alternative Fuel Stations
projects.description: Colorado Alternative Fuel Stations is a web application to discover alternative fuel stations and their relevant data acquired from data.colorado.gov. It is constructed with a Ruby on Rails back-end to persist and render JSON data to the AngularJS front-end.

projects.title: YogaFlow
projects.description: YogaFlow is a web app to create yoga sequences full of yoga poses. You can add pre-existing poses, create your own, and comment on the sequences. Technologies used include Ruby on Rails, JavaScript and jQuery.
